eras.note: 30 seats are elected from 16 unique district boundaries (mostly county-based); districts are capped at 3 senators each under this cycle's map, with Chittenden County split into 3 sub-districts. Veto override is 2/3 of members present — the seat figure here assumes full attendance. The app's composition data currently shows 29 total seats; the correct chamber size is 30.

redistricting.text: A new footprint: none of its population was in the 2016–2020 Addison; it draws from the old Addison-1 State House District (23%), the old Addison-4 State House District (22%), the old Addison-3 State House District (19%) and 6 more.
